title: Coast Guard Medevac Rescue Near Anclote River
description: A 30-year-old man was rescued by Coast Guard crew members from a 26-foot fishing vessel approximately 20 miles northwest of Anclote River Fla., Friday, April 12, 2013. A crewmember aboard the Mary D contacted watchstanders at Sector St. Petersburg via Rescue 21 VHF-FM channel 16 reporting a crewmember was experiencing severe stomach cramping and tingling in his extremities. U.S. Coast Guard video.
